description: $q captures only a restored T. It is still present and keeps its own tags ~mark, while head($q) and phonemes($q) see the empty original span. So tags($q) and tags(head($q)) differ (engine §7.5).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T U
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A $q(q)
%conditions $q ∧ ~mark ⊆ tags($q), tags(head($q)) = ∅, phonemes($q) = ""
%rule q [T] <~mark>
%rule b A [T] [U]
%rule c A T
